en.title: Anime's Hottest Summer Just Got Hotter: New Releases Drop July 12-18
en.summary: Get ready to binge! The North American anime and manga scene exploded this week with highly anticipated releases. From ongoing series to brand new manga, your watch and read lists are about to get a serious upgrade.
en.body:
The summer anime season is in full swing, and the week of July 12-18 delivered a tidal wave of new content for North American fans. Whether you're a seasoned binge-watcher or just dipping your toes into the vibrant world of Japanese animation and comics, there was something for everyone. Amazon Prime Video subscribers, for instance, could dive straight into season 2 of **Dan Da Dan** on launch day, a series that has quickly garnered a passionate following for its unique blend of action and offbeat humor.

Beyond the big streamer drops, the ongoing summer 2026 anime lineup continues to impress. Fans are treated to weekly episodes of established hits like **Grand Blue Season 3** and the ever-evolving cyberpunk world of **Ghost in the Shell**. These continued seasons underscore the enduring appeal of these franchises and the consistent demand for high-quality animated storytelling. The manga world also saw significant additions, with Viz Media announcing a slate of new titles. Among them are the debut of **Hima-Ten!, Vol. 1**, and new installments in popular series like **My Hero Academia: Team-Up Missions, Vol. 8**, alongside the intriguing **Not Manga Snow White**.

## A Feast for Fans

The sheer volume of new releases this week is a testament to the growing accessibility and popularity of anime and manga. Platforms like Crunchyroll and Netflix are becoming essential hubs for fans, offering a diverse catalog that caters to every taste. The buzz around series like **The Ghost in the Shell** adaptation on Prime Video and the upcoming **Dragon Ball Super: Beerus** shows a clear trend: fans are eager for both familiar universes reimagined and entirely new stories to fall in love with. This influx means that keeping up requires dedication – and likely, multiple subscriptions – but the payoff is a constant stream of engaging narratives that keep the community talking and theorizing.

## What's Next

Looking ahead, the excitement doesn't stop. While the July 12-18 window was packed, the pipeline remains robust. Keep an eye out for further updates on Netflix's ambitious slate, including the confirmed October 2026 premiere for **The Ramparts of Ice — Season 2** and the highly anticipated **Delicious in Dungeon — Season 2** in October 2027. The **JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: STEEL BALL RUN** adaptation also continues to build anticipation with new trailers and character reveals, promising another epic chapter for fans of Hirohiko Araki's legendary series.
